Method of Attack: Malicious npm package dependencies act as first-stage malware downloaders that connect to remote sites for additional payloads to execute on the infected machine
Social engineering campaign using fake developer and recruiter personas to invite targets to collaborate on projects with malicious npm dependencies
Impacted Systems: Developers' devices in blockchain, cryptocurrency, online gambling, and cybersecurity sectors
Attack Vector: Social engineering via GitHub and social media personas
Repository invitations with malicious npm package dependencies
Malicious npm packages downloading second-stage payloads from remote sites
Indicators of Compromise: Suspended GitHub and npm accounts associated with the campaign
Published list of domains, GitHub accounts, and npm packages linked to the campaign
